title: Keto Citrus Crumble Cheesecake Bars
description: A keto dessert recipe with a creamy cheesecake base topped with a festive crumble and a burst of citrus flavors.

ingredients.name: grated citrus zest (such as orange or lemon)

instructions: Prepare the crust by mixing the almond flour and granulated sweetener in a bowl.
Add the melted butter to the bowl and mix until the crust mixture is well combined.
Press the crust mixture into a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Bake the crust for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.
While the crust is baking, prepare the cheesecake filling.
Beat the cream cheese until smooth, then add the eggs one at a time.
Beat in the grated citrus zest.
Pour the cheesecake filling over the baked crust.
Top the cheesecake filling with the crumble topping.
Bake the cheesecake bars for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the center is set.
Let the cheesecake bars cool completely in the pan before cutting into bars and serving.
